en: Uh oh! My friend forgot his lunch today. But my lunch is only for me... or is it?
Listen! <SAW> taught us: food for two is enough for three, and food for three is enough for four!
So I break my sandwich in half. One half for me, and one half for you!
Then another friend sits down with us. We share the apple slices too!
Look! Everybody has enough, and everybody is smiling.
When we share, there is blessing in our food. It feels like more, not less!
Who will you share with tomorrow? Tell your grown-up!
